Subject: HelioBank renewal intake — timeline, exec availability & QBR windows

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our discussion, I wanted to kick off the renewal conversation so we can lock timelines and identify the right execs for the QBR. High-level goals: confirm term/commit options, align on capacity uplift (you mentioned ~2x burst months), and schedule the operational QBR + executive readout.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
- Share mutual action plan (attached) with milestone owners and dates
- Confirm legal/procurement contacts and PO timing
- Schedule two windows for QBR: ops-focused (technical stakeholders) and exec-facing (C-suite + account execs)

Can you confirm the people below (or add others) who should be on the two sessions? Also please confirm whether HelioBank prefers a single-day readout or two shorter sessions.

Suggested stakeholders from HelioBank: Jordan Mills (TPM), Sana Patel (Head of ML Ops), Procurement Team (procurement@heliofinance.com)
Suggested Redwood attendees: Ben Carter (AE), Laura Bennett (SE), Karthik Iyer (Customer Success)

I'm attaching a draft mutual action plan (XLSX) and a first-pass SOW outline for legal to review. If this looks good, I can follow up with a calendaring poll for the week of June 8–12 or June 22–26.

Best,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: HelioBank renewal intake — timeline, exec availability & QBR windows

Ben —

Appreciate the clear cadence. We can own internal coordination for attendees; confirmed participants so far: myself, Sana (Head of MLOps), and Rajiv from Infra (cc'd to procurement separately). Procurement looped in here for PO timing.

A couple of asks from our side before we finalize windows:
- Can you call out what the uplift unit economics look like at 2x steady-state? Want the delta on per-token cost and any burst billing mechanics.
- We have a compliance checkpoint the week of 5/25; if any contractual changes affect data residency or logging, legal will want to sign off prior to exec readout.

QBR windows: the June 8–12 slot works for the ops session for the most part. For the exec readout, June 23 or 24 are better for our C-suite. If you can run two half-day sessions (ops: 60–75 minutes; exec: 45 minutes), that would be ideal.

Jordan

Adding a few legal/ops notes — forwarding to procurement contact template.

- SOW draft updated with a narrow residency clause and a 30-day audit window (see attached SOW_Draft_HelioBank_v1.pdf). This keeps the core terms unchanged but makes it easier for Helio's Legal to sign quickly.
- If they want an interim PO to secure Dedicated pool capacity, procurement typically asks for a 3–5 week lead time on GPUs for Dedicated reservations; we should flag that for the ops session.
- I recommend we propose the ops session agenda as: 1) current usage and bottlenecks (15m), 2) uplift sizing & timing (20m), 3) billing mechanics & contract changes (15–20m), 4) open Q&A (10m).

Attaching SOW draft and an updated mutual action plan with owners.

Laura

Confirming: ops session week of June 8 (we prefer the 9th or 10th), exec session on June 24 at 11:00am ET. Sana will send attendee confirmations by EOD Monday 5/18.

Jordan
